notes: Original prints partial eta-squared .16 and p_rep = .97 for the target ANOVA; p_rep is not a conventional p-value, so original p is null. Original locator p. 4 differs from the result on journal p. 1221 (PDF p. 3). Replication locator p. 10 is outside the seven-page published article. Input is internally inconsistent: study_r = 1 names the cleanliness-word priming experiment, while the neutral description and original study_o = 2 name hand washing after disgust. Replication fields follow the explicit study_r = 1 and target_match is false because its manipulation/sample/test do not match the described hand-washing target. The same replication paper separately reports hand-washing Experiment 2 on p. 212: analytic N = 126, Cohen’s d = 0.01, F(1, 124) = 0.001, p = .97. Those distinct-study values are not merged into the Experiment 1 fields. Cached replication source is a partial web parse of publisher full text hosted in ResearchGate HTML, with title/DOI verified; source text has a private-use glyph for minus, transcribed as a minus in es.value. No metric conversions performed.
